slides.text: Everyone online talks about it. What's true? 👉

slides.title: An experimental Lilly peptide
slides.text: It acts on three receptors at once: GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon. Tirzepatide acts on two, semaglutide on one.
Neither the FDA nor the EMA has approved it. Phase 3 trials are ongoing, some until 2029.
Average body weight loss after 48 weeks in the phase 2 trial (NEJM, 2023). The full safety picture will only come from large phase 3 trials.
